first.rationale: Onboarding completion is currently declining and simplifying onboarding has previously improved time-to-value and early adoption, making it the strongest immediate lever for restoring activation without broadly discounting. Verify the onboarding result and the pricing evidence before committing, since promotional pricing may address competitor-driven SMB loss but could weaken sustainable revenue quality. Use a guarded test with downstream qualified-revenue and retention metrics, not completion alone.
